confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Drinks are less certain: beer is anchored to typical Italian draft pricing, and cocktail and wine are set from the local price relationship to beer and spritz-level pricing. Accommodation is the least certain because July is peak season and Verona's summer Arena opera season raises hotel rates, so the hotel and hostel anchors are wider bounds. USD conversions assume roughly 1 EUR = 1.15 USD. FX: the 2026-10-16 RBA observation (0.6947 USD per AUD) was taken from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages and was not read directly from the F11.1 table, so verify it before relying on it. A 15 Oct 2026 figure of 0.6955 also appeared, and the 16 Oct value is the one used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized northern Italian tourist cities with similar demand, such as Padua, Vicenza and Bergamo, adjusted upward for Verona's high summer tourism and Arena season accommodation premium. Restaurant prices follow typical Veneto trattoria and pizzeria levels.
